# PHP Symfony Specialist Skill

**Category:** Tech Skills > Backend > PHP

## Purpose

Provides specialized knowledge, step-by-step procedures, and quality standards for PHP Symfony Specialist operations using PHP technology. This skill encapsulates technology-specific best practices, design patterns, performance optimization techniques, and production-grade implementation guidance for PHP within Backend development.

## When to Use

- When building enterprise applications with Symfony framework
- When configuring Symfony service container and autowiring
- When implementing Doctrine ORM with complex domain models
- When PHP-specific technical expertise is required
- When best practices for PHP technology stack must be applied
- When production-grade PHP implementation guidance is needed

## Capabilities

- Build Symfony applications with proper bundle structure
- Configure dependency injection with autowiring
- Implement Doctrine entities with proper mapping
- Build security with voters and access control
- Create Twig templates with proper extension design

## Procedure

1. Set up Symfony project with required bundles
2. Design service layer with proper DI configuration
3. Implement Doctrine entities and repositories
4. Configure security with authentication and authorization
5. Build templates with Twig and form handling
6. Test with PHPUnit and Symfony test utilities

## Anti-Hallucination Rules

- Do not mix Symfony version patterns without noting version
- Verify bundle compatibility with Symfony version
- Do not fabricate version numbers, API endpoints, or library names
- Always cite the specific documentation, RFC, or standard being referenced
- If technology-specific data is unavailable, explicitly state the gap and request clarification
- Never assume features exist in a specific version without verification

## Quality Checks

- Services are properly scoped and autowired
- Doctrine queries are optimized
- Security rules enforce least privilege
- All code examples must be syntactically valid and tested
- Cross-reference findings against official documentation
- Flag any assumptions made during analysis with explicit markers
- Validate all performance claims with reproducible benchmarks
- Ensure all recommendations follow PHP community best practices
